title: xDrip occupies too much storage space on the phone
body:
Xdrip version: 17cbcfo-2021.03.08
code:210308´1944
downgradable to: 1603091400

phone: Samsung j7 2016

Android 8.1.0

from yesterday (05-18-2021) to today (05-19-2021) the spaces change from 791 megas to 836 megas only in one day

save database daily is not enable

Do you have verbose logging enabled (less common settings - extra logging settings - extra tags for logging)?

What "Glucose Retention" have you set? 0?
You could also do a backup of the database and look at its uncompressed size.
yes, right now i will make that backup and maybe unistall and re-install if there is no another solution posible

At what is the largest table inside the SQlite database? I assume, `UserErrors`.

You still did not report whether you have extra logging enabled or not. I assume that this is the main reason of having such a large xDrip database.
save database daily is not enable

> ¿Tiene habilitado el registro detallado (configuraciones menos comunes, configuraciones de registro adicionales, etiquetas adicionales para el registro)?
> 
> ¿Qué "Retención de glucosa" ha establecido? 0?

Glucose Retention 120 days

```
DESERTSYNC........................................ 144634 73.5%
USERERRORS........................................ 37184 18.9%
```
As you can see, most of the space is occupied by the desert sync feature. Do you really use it? If not, disable it in the "xDrip+ Sync settings".

Also, quite a lot of messages are logged to the USERERRORS table. I've asked you several times, if you have enabled some verbose logging (search the settings by "Extra tags".

@NickAlbanese85 

Please go to Settings -> xDrip+ Sync settings -> Desert Sync
Is it on?

Please go to Settings -> Less common settings -> Extra Logging Settings -> Extra tags for logging
Please show what you see

@NickAlbanese85 
Please tap on "Etiquetas extra para el registro", and show what you see.

> @ NickAlbanese85
> Por favor toque "Etiquetas extra para el registro" y muestre lo que ve.

![Uploading Screenshot_20210522-164808_xDrip+.jpg…]()

@NickAlbanese85 Please upload it the same way you uploaded the previous images.
We cannot see the last image.

Solucionado

Gracias a un desarrollador argentino hemos encontrado el inconveniente se daba en que xdrip contenia un fallo que reseteaba la aplicacion al menos 30 veces al dia, por lo cual no podia llegar a 24 horas para limpiar datos viejos y asi iba cargando cada vez mas y mas datos.

La solucion consistio en generar un backup de los datos para su reparacion, desinstalar y reinstalar la aplicacion.
